cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(native_dependency_fixtures LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT MSVC)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "These import-table fixtures require MSVC")
endif()
add_library(zlib SHARED zlib.cpp)
add_library(direct_consumer SHARED consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(direct_consumer PRIVATE zlib)
add_library(delayed_consumer SHARED consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(delayed_consumer PRIVATE zlib delayimp)
target_link_options(delayed_consumer PRIVATE /DELAYLOAD:zlib.dll)
add_library(debug_consumer SHARED consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(debug_consumer PRIVATE zlib)
set_property(TARGET debug_consumer PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreadedDebugDLL)
